subject: ACME procurement: PO vs marketplace / next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tina Johnson <tina.johnson@acmecorp.com>
Cc: dev.patel@redwood.com, michael.grant@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: ACME procurement: PO vs marketplace / next steps

Hi Tina —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

- Current intent: ACME is evaluating Redwood for inference across a small set of production routes (search re-ranking + chat).
- Procurement path: need to confirm whether finance will do PO (preferred) or pay by card. Also asked whether ACME prefers us to go through AWS Marketplace or direct vendor relationship.
- Required artifacts: procurement mentioned vendor onboarding form, W9, SOW, and SOC 2 summary.

Proposed next steps (can we confirm these?):
1) I'll share a draft SOW + W9 + SOC2 summary (attached).
2) Please confirm whether we should upload these to your vendor portal (procurement@acmecorp.com) or if you prefer we initiate DocuSign for an MSA.
3) If PO is the path, can you confirm standard PO terms (net30/net45) and whether any additional contract redlines are expected?
4) If ACME is interested in Marketplace, tell us which marketplace (AWS/GCP) — we can provide pricing SKU and procurement onboarding steps.

If it helps, I can put together a short mutual action plan (1 pager) with target dates for onboarding and a checklist for procurement/legal.

Attaching: Redwood_SOW_template.pdf (draft), Redwood_W9.pdf.

Thanks — looking to keep momentum and get a sense of timeline.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (555) 555-0123

--
Redwood Inference — inference runtime for production-grade LLMs

From: Tina Johnson <tina.johnson@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Procurement <procurement@acmecorp.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACME procurement: PO vs marketplace / next steps

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few notes from procurement: 

- Our preferred path is a standard PO (we do not use card for annual commitments).
- To progress the vendor onboarding we need: vendor onboarding form (I've CC'd procurement@acmecorp.com), a completed W9, our internal vendor questionnaire, and a short SOC2 summary.
- Timeline: once we have the completed forms + SOW, vendor onboarding typically takes 2-3 weeks; legal review can add a week depending on redlines.

We are evaluating marketplace options but would prefer direct vendor relationship for the first year — if the pricing is comparable, we may move to marketplace later.

I've added procurement@acmecorp.com to the thread so our onboarding team sees the attachments. Please also include any sample MSA language you expect to be non-negotiable (indemnity, data handling).

Thanks — I'll loop back when procurement assigns a reviewer.

Tina
Tina Johnson
Sr. Manager, Vendor Relations
Acme Corp

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tina Johnson <tina.johnson@acmecorp.com>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acmecorp.com>
Cc: dev.patel@redwood.com, michael.grant@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 27 Aug 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: RE: ACME procurement: PO vs marketplace / next steps — weekly check-in

Hi Tina / procurement team —

Quick weekly check-in to see where things are and what (if anything) is blocking us from getting the PO started. Per your ask, I've attached: 
- Redwood_SOW_template.pdf (draft SOW — we can tailor scope to the two routes we discussed)
- redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (SOC 2 summary + control highlights)
- Redwood_W9.pdf

Questions to help move this along: 
- Would you like us to upload these documents to your vendor portal or do you prefer we submit via email? If portal, please confirm the contact and any form IDs.
- Do you want Redwood legal (cc'd: dev.patel@redwood.com) to do an initial pass on your vendor questionnaire so we can pre-fill common answers and speed review?
- Confirm PO payment terms (you mentioned net30 on the call — is that standard?)

Proposed next steps:
1) Procurement confirms portal vs email and expected timeline.
2) If PO: procurement shares PO template / required PO fields.
3) If any contract redlines are expected, schedule a short 30-min legal sync next week with Dev (Redwood).

If it's helpful I can produce a 1-week mutual action plan with owners and dates. Happy to jump on a brief call if that helps unblock.

Thanks — appreciate the help keeping this moving.

Best,
Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachment stubs: Redwood_SOW_template.pdf, redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, Redwood_W9.pdf
